title: Travel: John Lennon – New York to Tokyo | 1979
content:
John Lennon, Yoko Ono, and Sean Lennon flew from New York to Tokyo on 28 July 1979.

They stayed at the Hotel Okura and remained in Japan until 28 August, when they flew back to the USA.
